definition: Thickness or density, especially the close, obscuring density of fog, darkness, or a crowd.
etymology: It comes from Latin spissitudo, “thickness,” from spissus, “thick” or “close-packed.” The word arrived in English carrying the sense of something pressed so closely together that little can pass through it.
usage: By early November, the river valley had acquired a spissitude of mist that swallowed the far bank.
